title: adam Run Result
description: Structured result emitted by every dispatch, every review, and the e2e-acceptance pass. Lives at scratch/run-results/<id>.json.

kind.description: Which phase produced this result. `manage` is emitted by the Tier-2 dispatch-manager subagent in the 3-tier topology.

id.description: Slice id, project name, or other identifier this result is keyed by

issue_url.description: For tracker-backed slices (GitHub issues, Linear tickets, etc.): URL of the originating issue. Lets reviewers jump from a run-result back to the source spec without inferring from `id`.

pr_url.description: For slices that ship via a pull request opened by `pr-from-slice`: URL of the PR. Lets reviewers jump from a run-result straight to the merged (or in-flight) PR. Distinct from `issue_url` so both can coexist.

status.description: `code-complete` = worker did all it could; an `operator_command` follows (matches `human_gated: true` in the slice SPEC). `human-gated` = the orchestrator has paused this branch awaiting the operator action.

verdict.description: For `kind: review` and `kind: e2e`: the machine-readable review gate derived from `review_findings` that survived the reviewer contract. `approve` = no critical/warning findings (a clean zero-finding review is valid); `warning` = warning findings only; `block` = one or more critical findings. The Tier-1 orchestrator reads this to decide whether a slice advances; a `block` keeps the slice off `done` in agent-control/slice-status.md.

branch.description: For dispatch results: the branch the subagent committed to

subagent.description: For dispatch/manage results: which subagent ran

verifier.description: Result of running `slices/<id>/verify.sh` (or the inline `verify:` one-liner). Required on `kind: dispatch` and `kind: manage`. The Tier-1 orchestrator independently re-runs this before flipping a slice-status row to `done`.

stderr_tail.description: Last ~400 chars of stderr, or empty

manager_verify.description: For `kind: dispatch` results: the Tier-2 manager's smoke run of the verifier. Distinct from the Tier-1 orchestrator's independent re-run.

operator_command.description: For `status: code-complete` or `status: human-gated`: the exact shell command (or step) a human must run before this slice can flip to `done`.

e2e_command.description: For e2e kind: exact Playwright (or wrapper) command that was run

playwright_report_path.description: For e2e kind: path to HTML report or test-results dir if generated

verification_layers.description: For e2e kind: per-layer outcome from packet verification.layers (step 2c)

id.description: ui_e2e | api_e2e | integration | contract | agentic_qa | dependency_audit | sast | secret_scan | authz_review | security_headers

out_of_scope_violations.description: Files modified that were listed under paths_out_of_scope

security_audit_path.description: For security-audit / security-acceptance: path to audit JSON baseline

security_findings.description: For security-acceptance: open or closed findings reconciled against audit

source.description: code-review-graph | log-reader-mcp | chrome-devtools | playwright | cursor-ide-browser | security-audit | bandit | semgrep | gitleaks | manual
